description: Search the official ANAE nomenclature: the list of activities that the Agence Nationale de l'Auto-Entrepreneur opens to the auto-entrepreneur status in Algeria, grouped in domains. Use it to check whether an activity can be practised as an auto-entrepreneur and to find its six-digit code. Returns a page of activities with code, labels and domain. meta.total is the number of matches. In Algeria an activity that has a regime of its own, today 080101 (micro-importation), also carries the object regime: read it before answering about that activity, it is not the ordinary auto-entrepreneur regime (see get_anae_activity). For Morocco (country MA) the status is defined by exclusion: it returns the professions that decree 2-15-263 excludes from the auto-entrepreneur status (architects, lawyers, doctors, notaries and so on), each with key (an UpGrowth identifier, code is null: Morocco gives them no code), status excluded and its legal basis; it holds no list of eligible activities. Morocco needs an API key. Without an API key at most 10 rows come back and meta.truncated says when more matched, so do not present such a list as complete. For Tunisia (country TN) there is no list of activities: the one record is the regime of the auto-entrepreneur as the finance law 2023 states it (key regime), and meta.activity_list says that the official list of activities is not loaded, so an activity that is not in the answer is neither admitted nor excluded: never tell a user it is not eligible. Tunisia needs an API key.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

domain.description: Keep only activities of this ANAE domain, given by its six-digit domain code (it ends in 0000), for example 010000 for Advice, Expertise and Training. Every result carries its domain. Not used for Tunisia (country TN): it has one regime record and no domains.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

limit.description: Maximum number of results in the page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20. Without an API key at most 10 rows come back.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, from 0 to 10000, to read the next pages. Defaults to 0. meta.total tells how many results match. Without an API key it must be 0: a search cannot be paged.

q.description: Search text, at most 100 characters. Digits only: matches the ANAE codes that start with them. Words: every word must start a word of the activity label in French, Arabic or English. Accents and letter case are ignored. Leave it out to browse by domain.

name: search_anae_activities
title: Search ANAE auto-entrepreneur activities
